blocks.x: Rollouts follow the Dataq Method on this platform's rails:

items: Baseline metrics locked; data-readiness assessed against the platform's contracts.
Pilot on a bounded scope with pre-agreed criteria and the platform configured for your controls.
Staged rollout with SLO instrumentation, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models/policies, conformance monitoring, quarterly value reviews.

blocks.x: Operators describe the change as boring, in the best sense: the platform handles the recoverable failures by policy, pages humans only on user impact, and every intervention is logged into the evidence trail automatically.

Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
